> **Gladys → Echo**: Gladys makes your Echo speak. Not to be confused with Gladys' **Amazon Alexa** integration (with Gladys Plus), which lets you control Gladys by voice from Alexa; both can run side by side.

Make your Echos speak in your scenes, run your Alexa routines, and control music, volume and Do Not
Disturb from Gladys.

> **Unofficial and not affiliated with Amazon.** This integration uses the web API of the Alexa app,
> which Amazon does not document: it may stop working when Amazon changes it.
>
> **Developed without the hardware: feedback welcome.** Tell us on the Gladys forum what works with
> your Echos and what does not.

## Before you start

- Gladys 5.1.0 or later.
- Your Amazon account, with your Echos set up in the Alexa app.
- A **computer** for the sign-in: on a phone with the Alexa app installed, Amazon may open the app
  instead of the sign-in page.

## Sign in to Amazon

You do this once. Gladys never sees your password: you sign in on Amazon's own page.

1. Open **Integrations → Echo Media Player → Configuration**.
2. Choose your **Amazon marketplace** (the site of your account: amazon.fr, amazon.de…) and click
   **Save**.
3. Click **Connect**. Amazon's sign-in page opens in a new tab. It is the **Amazon Alexa page on
   amazon.com**, even for an amazon.fr or amazon.de account, and that is expected: the Alexa app
   always signs in there, then Gladys uses your marketplace. The page speaks the language of your
   marketplace. (For Japan, it is amazon.co.jp.)
4. Sign in: email, password, and the verification code if two-step verification is on.
5. Amazon then shows a page that looks **empty, broken or "page not found"**. That is expected: the
   address of this page carries the authorization.
6. Click the address bar and copy the **whole address**. It starts with
   `https://www.amazon.com/ap/maplanding?` (even for an amazon.fr account) and is long.
7. Back in Gladys, at the bottom of the Configuration tab, paste it in **Finish the sign-in** and run
   the action, **within a few minutes** (the code expires quickly and works once).
8. The answer says how many Echos were found. The status at the top turns to connected.
9. Open the **Discover** tab and add your Echos.

Gladys now appears as an "Amazon Alexa" device in your Amazon account. To undo everything, run
**Sign out of Amazon**: the credentials are deleted from Gladys and that device is removed from your
account.

### If it fails

- _"This is not the return address"_: you copied the address too early (or the sign-in page itself).
  Finish signing in, then copy the address of the page that follows.
- _"This address does not come from the sign-in page Gladys opened"_: the pasted address does not
  start with `https://www.amazon.com/ap/maplanding?` (an amazon.fr page opened by hand, for
  instance). Click **Connect** again and copy the address of the page that follows the sign-in.
- _"Amazon refused the sign-in"_: the code was already used or too old. Click **Connect** and start
  again, a bit faster.
- _"Amazon refused the stored sign-in"_ (later on): the registration was removed from your account,
  or your password changed. Sign in again.

## Your Echos in Gladys

Each Echo is a device. Each multi-room group too.

| Feature                | Echo | Group | Notes                                |
| ---------------------- | ---- | ----- | ------------------------------------ |
| Volume                 | yes  | no    | 0 to 100                             |
| Do not disturb         | yes  | no    | on / off                             |
| Play, pause, prev/next | yes¹ | yes   |                                      |
| Playback state         | yes¹ | yes   | 0 paused, 1 playing, 2 stopped       |
| Now playing            | yes¹ | yes   | "Title — Artist"                     |
| Title, artist, album   | yes¹ | yes   | Gladys 5.3 music player              |
| Artwork                | yes¹ | yes   | Gladys 5.3 music player              |
| Duration, position     | yes¹ | yes   | Gladys 5.3 music player              |
| Notification           | yes  | yes   | for the core's "Play a notification" |

¹ Echos with a music player (not the Echo Spot without music, for instance).

The states are read every 2 minutes by default (**Refresh interval** in the configuration), only for
the Echos you added. Amazon blocks accounts that call it too often: do not go below the default
without a reason.

The **Language of names and messages** setting gives the names of the features of the Echos you add
afterwards (Gladys keeps them once a device is added) and the language of the error messages.

## Gladys 5.3 music player

From Gladys 5.3, the core's **Music** widget is a real player. Add it to a dashboard and choose an
Echo: artwork, title, artist and album, the progress bar, play-pause (and stop through the playback
state), previous / next and the volume. The values are those of the refresh (every 2 minutes by
default) and of the reading made 3 seconds after each command: a track started by voice shows up at
the next refresh.

- **Echos added before version 1.1.0**: open **Discover** in the integration and click **Update**
  on each Echo to add the new features (title, artist, album, artwork, duration, position). Scenes
  and dashboards keep working: no feature changes its identifier.
- **Playback state**: 2 (stopped) when nothing is loaded, where version 1.0 gave 0. A scene that
  waited for 0 on a stop must now wait for 2. Writing 2 stops the Echo, like "Alexa, stop".
- **Not available**, the Alexa web API cannot do it: seeking in a track (the bar is read-only),
  shuffle and repeat (Amazon does not report them when read), mute, the queue and browsing or
  searching the music services (no catalog panel).
- The **Echo player** widget of the integration stays, with Do Not Disturb.

## In scenes

**Make an Echo speak** (Echo Media Player actions):

- **Echos**: one or several; a group speaks through its speakers.
- **Text to say**: scene variables are allowed. Up to 1,000 characters; Alexa says long texts in
  pieces of 250 characters.
- **How**: _Speak_ (the Echo just talks) or _Announcement_ (a chime first, on every chosen Echo at
  once). An announcement always carries the name of the Alexa account. Devices with Alexa built in
  that are not Echo (the Devialet player of the Freebox Delta, for instance) accept the
  announcement but stay silent, without any error: use _Speak_ on them.
- **Volume** (optional): set before speaking, then the previous volume comes back.

**Run an Alexa routine**: type the name of the routine as in the Alexa app, or the phrase that
triggers it. The **List my Alexa routines** button of the configuration shows the names. Choose an
Echo if the routine has steps acting on "the device you speak to".

**Echo: Do Not Disturb**: on or off, on one or several Echos.

**Play a notification** (the core's action, in the Music category) also works with an Echo, but
needs **Gladys Plus**: the core turns your text into an audio file there and sends only its address
(and not the volume). Alexa plays an audio file only in some formats; if your Echo stays silent,
use **Make an Echo speak**, which sends the text itself.

## Dashboard widget

Add the **Echo player** widget and choose an Echo: title, artist, state, Do Not Disturb, the live
volume and previous / play-pause / next buttons.

## Limitations

- Unofficial API: it can break when Amazon changes it.
- No mute, seek, shuffle or repeat (the web API offers none, or does not report them), and no
  scene trigger (nothing reliable to start a scene on).
- Two speeches sent at the same moment may interrupt each other.
- Tested only against reconstructed answers, never on a real account yet.

## Privacy

The integration stores, in its own folder of Gladys (`/data`, readable by the integration only):
the refresh token of the "Amazon Alexa" registration, the marketplace and your Amazon customer id.
Nothing else, and never in the logs. It talks only to Amazon.

## Parámetros de configuración

Estos son los parámetros que Echo Media Player te pide en su pantalla de configuración en Gladys.

| Parámetro | Tipo | Obligatorio | Descripción |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Antes de empezar | `section` | No | Esta integración usa la API web de la aplicación Alexa, que Amazon no documenta: puede dejar de funcionar cuando Amazon la cambie. No está afiliada a Amazon. Desarrollada sin el hardware: se agradecen sus comentarios. |
| Sitio de Amazon | `select` | Sí | El sitio donde está su cuenta de Amazon (el de la aplicación Alexa). Guarde antes de hacer clic en Conectar. |
| Inicio de sesión en Amazon | `section` | No | 1. Haga clic en Conectar: la página de inicio de sesión de Amazon se abre en una pestaña nueva. Es la de Amazon Alexa en amazon.com, incluso para una cuenta de amazon.es: es normal. Inicie sesión (contraseña, código de verificación). Gladys nunca ve su contraseña. 2. Amazon muestra luego una página que parece vacía o rota: es normal. Copie su dirección completa de la barra de direcciones (empieza por https:\/\/www.amazon.com/ap/maplanding). 3. En los cinco minutos siguientes, péguela en la acción «Terminar el inicio de sesión» al final de esta página. Use un ordenador: en un teléfono con la aplicación Alexa, Amazon puede abrir la aplicación. |
| Cuenta de Amazon | `account_link` | No |  |
| Idioma de los nombres y mensajes | `select` | No | Nombres de las funciones de los Echo añadidos a partir de ahora (Gladys los conserva una vez añadido el dispositivo) y mensajes de error de comandos y escenas. |
| Intervalo de actualización | `select` | No | Frecuencia de lectura del volumen, la música y el modo No molestar. Amazon bloquea las cuentas que llaman demasiado: manténgalo lento. |

## Cómo instalar Echo Media Player en Gladys

1. En Gladys, abre **Integraciones**: Echo Media Player aparece en el catálogo junto a las integraciones nativas, con una insignia de comunidad.
2. Haz clic en **Instalar**. Gladys descarga la imagen Docker (`ghcr.io/guim31/gladys-amazon-echo:1.1.0`), la ejecuta en un entorno aislado del núcleo y genera la interfaz de la integración (dispositivos, descubrimiento y configuración).
3. Abre la pantalla de **Configuración** de la integración, rellena los parámetros y guarda.
4. También puedes instalarla directamente desde la URL de su repositorio: [https://github.com/guim31/gladys-amazon-echo](https://github.com/guim31/gladys-amazon-echo).

Echo Media Player requiere Gladys `>=5.3.0`. El catálogo de Gladys se actualiza cada hora, así que una nueva versión está disponible como máximo una hora después de publicarse.

¿Todavía no usas Gladys? Es gratuito y de código abierto: [sigue la guía de instalación](/es/docs/) para empezar.

## Sobre las integraciones externas

Echo Media Player es una **integración externa**: una integración comunitaria empaquetada como contenedor Docker y publicada en GitHub. Gladys la instala con un clic y la ejecuta en un entorno aislado del núcleo. La publica y mantiene [guim31](https://github.com/guim31), no el equipo principal de Gladys.
